title: Exact-functor localization preserves commutative cubes
statement: Let C,D,E,F,G,H,I,J be arbitrary abelian categories with derived categories. Let a:C→D, b:D→E, c:E→F, d:C→G, e:G→E, f:G→H, g:H→F, h:C→I, i:I→H, j:D→J, k:J→F, m:I→J be exact additive functors. Given six natural isomorphisms q1:a⋙b≅d⋙e, q2:e⋙c≅f⋙g, q3:d⋙f≅h⋙i, q4:b⋙c≅j⋙k, q5:a⋙j≅h⋙m, q6:m⋙k≅i⋙g, suppose c(q1_X);q2_dX;g(q3_X)=q4_aX;k(q5_X);q6_hX for every X. Derive each face by inverse composition comparison, mapDerivedCategoryNatIso, and composition comparison. Then the two three-face derived paths are equal as natural transformations on the full unbounded derived category. No scheme, site comparison, coefficient ring or boundedness hypothesis occurs.

proof.text: Apply Localization.natTrans_ext for DerivedCategory.Q. Postcompose the two paths with g applied to the i and h localization factors and the g factor. Use mapDerivedCategoryCompIso_fac and mapDerivedCategoryNatIso_fac on each face, with naturality to move all factors to the source. Both sides are the same source factors followed by Q of the two ordinary complex morphisms.

Apply HomologicalComplex.Hom.ext degreewise to the assumed ordinary cube equation. Functoriality of Q gives equality of the localized composites. Cancel the target factorization isomorphisms and conclude by localization extensionality. The proof works also for zero categories and identity faces.

theorem mapDerivedCategory_exactCube
    (q1 : a ⋙ b ≅ d ⋙ e)
    (q2 : e ⋙ c ≅ f ⋙ g)
    (q3 : d ⋙ f ≅ h ⋙ i)
    (q4 : b ⋙ c ≅ j ⋙ k)
    (q5 : a ⋙ j ≅ h ⋙ m)
    (q6 : m ⋙ k ≅ i ⋙ g)
    (comm : ∀ X : C,
      c.map (q1.hom.app X) ≫ q2.hom.app (d.obj X) ≫ g.map (q3.hom.app X) =
        q4.hom.app (a.obj X) ≫ k.map (q5.hom.app X) ≫ q6.hom.app (h.obj X)) :
    let s1 := (mapDerivedCategoryCompIso a b).symm ≪≫
      mapDerivedCategoryNatIso q1 ≪≫ mapDerivedCategoryCompIso d e
    let s2 := (mapDerivedCategoryCompIso e c).symm ≪≫
      mapDerivedCategoryNatIso q2 ≪≫ mapDerivedCategoryCompIso f g
    let s3 := (mapDerivedCategoryCompIso d f).symm ≪≫
      mapDerivedCategoryNatIso q3 ≪≫ mapDerivedCategoryCompIso h i
    let s4 := (mapDerivedCategoryCompIso b c).symm ≪≫
      mapDerivedCategoryNatIso q4 ≪≫ mapDerivedCategoryCompIso j k
    let s5 := (mapDerivedCategoryCompIso a j).symm ≪≫
      mapDerivedCategoryNatIso q5 ≪≫ mapDerivedCategoryCompIso h m
    let s6 := (mapDerivedCategoryCompIso m k).symm ≪≫
      mapDerivedCategoryNatIso q6 ≪≫ mapDerivedCategoryCompIso i g
    whiskerRight s1.hom c.mapDerivedCategory ≫
        whiskerLeft d.mapDerivedCategory s2.hom ≫
        whiskerRight s3.hom g.mapDerivedCategory =
      whiskerLeft a.mapDerivedCategory s4.hom ≫
        whiskerRight s5.hom k.mapDerivedCategory ≫
        whiskerLeft h.mapDerivedCategory s6.hom
